note: Yards under the deck, draft 6 (27 October 2026): layout A in Ben’s buildable area: two long yards end to end with extra tracks where the area widens, a CVG-type stub fan in the lower left, the departure line and freight ramp up the east side to the CS bridge. Track spacing 4.5 m (the real yard), No. 8 turnouts in the yard and No. 10 at the bridge, compound ladders (14.3/7.15 deg). Footprint measured like today’s yard (tracks + 3 m, gaps under 24 m closed).
